items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I see it sometimes where they do the Garrison Keillor radio show.

ctx.x: Live drama like that is very rare these days, to have things that are that.
Yeah. I see it sometimes where they do the Garrison Keillor radio show. They still do a lot of that. So it’s very reminiscent, and you enjoy it.
That’s right. You were with ABC for quite a long . . . .
